hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM backed by Euler Finance vault positions. In beforeSwap, it computes swap amounts using a custom bonding curve (CurveLib), deposits input tokens into and withdraws output tokens from Euler vaults (FundsLib), and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to handle all swap accounting outside of standard pool math. Native concentrated liquidity, initialization by non-factory callers, and donations are intentionally blocked.
